$comment: Generated by pnpm features:sync from packages/features/src/registry.ts. Only config.deployment and config.features are constrained.

deployment.description: Which product this install is. Only OpenWork Cloud sets "cloud". Renders DEN_DEPLOYMENT.

offlineRecovery.description: Connection failure presentation: Show compact App connection failures and a discreet offline indicator in OpenCode v2 conversations. Renders DEN_FEATURE_OFFLINE_RECOVERY.

rememberLastOrganization.description: Remember last organization: Return to the last organization used by the same account on this server after signing in again. Invite and installation links keep their selected organization. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMEMBER_LAST_ORGANIZATION.

secureSecretFields.description: Secure keys in chat: When an agent sets up a connection, plugin or AI Gateway provider that needs keys, people enter them in private fields in the chat and the agent continues once they are saved. Key fields across OpenWork and OpenWork Cloud can be shown while typing and show saved keys as Replace rows. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SECURE_SECRET_FIELDS.

memberListToolbars.description: Members: consistent list toolbars: Filter members, teams and roles beside their add action, with compact member rows and secondary actions in the list menu. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MEMBER_LIST_TOOLBARS.

appBuildProgress.description: App build progress: While an agent creates or changes an MCP App, the chat shows each stage it goes through (finding and checking tools, writing the App, building and verifying it) as a checklist with a progress bar. Renders DEN_FEATURE_APP_BUILD_PROGRESS.

modelsAnalyticsUi.description: Models analytics: Organization admins can view Models & usage analytics and shared model usage limits. Deprecated 2026-10-14: UI hidden behind modelsAnalyticsUi (default off). Most likely delete within 4 weeks (by 2026-11-11) unless an org depends on it. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MODELS_ANALYTICS_UI.

taskAnalyticsUi.description: Task analytics: Members with analytics access can view task activity and consumption, and admins can configure analytics integrations. Deprecated 2026-10-14: UI hidden behind taskAnalyticsUi (default off). Most likely delete within 4 weeks (by 2026-11-11) unless an org depends on it. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TASK_ANALYTICS_UI.

desktopPolicyScreenRemoval.description: Desktop suggestions in teams: Manage prompt suggestions in Everyone and team Desktop tabs instead of Advanced Desktop policies. Requires team page tabs; turning off restores the policy screens without changing stored policies. Renders DEN_FEATURE_DESKTOP_POLICY_SCREEN_REMOVAL.

teamMembershipCache.description: Team membership cache: Reduce repeated team lookups while keeping access changes immediate. Enable only after every API instance runs revision-aware team writes. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TEAM_MEMBERSHIP_CACHE.

managedDeploymentsGcp.description: GCP managed deployments: Organization admins approve OpenWork installations in their own Google Cloud project and track health and updates. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS_GCP.

managedDeploymentsMcp.description: Managed deployments in agents: Agents connected to OpenWork can check deployment readiness, create deployments, prepare the cloud approval link or command, and follow progress until the deployment is ready. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS_MCP.

managedDeployments.description: Managed deployments: Organization admins install OpenWork in their own cloud account (AWS first) and see its health and updates in OpenWork. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS.

slackAssistant.description: Slack Assistant: Answers Slack mentions and DMs for the organization after the Slack connector is set up. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_ASSISTANT.

slackWorkbotReplies.description: Slack: replies like Workbot: OpenWork in Slack writes its reply as it works, reacts to messages with an emoji, and takes bigger jobs into the background, posting the result in the thread when done. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_WORKBOT_REPLIES.

workbot.description: Workbot: Members can use Workbot, with side chats, a Calendar tab of its scheduled work and the option to run stopped tasks again, and organization admins choose the default model Workbot, the Slack assistant and cloud Automations answer with. Needs the deployment's Workbot app. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT.

automationCalendar.description: Calendar: desktop app: Members see a Calendar in the desktop app with their Automations next to meetings from their connected Google or Outlook calendar. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTOMATION_CALENDAR.

permissions.description: Permissions: Organization admins choose what members, admins and each team can do, instead of the fixed Member and Admin defaults. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PERMISSIONS.

permissionRules.description: Permission rules: Organization admins add OpenCode permission rules to Member, Admin and team permissions for the commands, websites, local skills and local MCP servers members' apps may use. Needs Permissions. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PERMISSION_RULES.

teamRoles.description: Team roles: Members › Teams shows each team's role (Member, Admin or Custom) with one Change role action, and Members gets a Roles tab to see and create roles. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TEAM_ROLES.

sharedRoles.description: Shared roles: A custom role can be given to more than one team: Change role lists every role, each role's page lists its teams, and a role can be created before any team has it. Needs Team roles and Permissions. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SHARED_ROLES.

agentPermissions.description: Agent permissions: Organization admins choose what agents can do on members' computers: run commands, edit files, open websites and use local skills and MCP servers, for everyone or per team. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AGENT_PERMISSIONS.

engineV2Upgrade.description: Desktop: upgrade prompt to OpenCode v2: Desktop members still on OpenCode v1 see a short notice offering to upgrade: their chats are copied to v2 with a backup, then OpenWork switches engines. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ENGINE_V2_UPGRADE.

remoteSessionEvents.description: Remote session events: MCP clients can subscribe to changes in their remote session receipts and read the current state after reconnecting. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_EVENTS.

backgroundShellTasks.description: Desktop: running background tasks in chat: The desktop chat shows how many commands the agent left running in the background, and adds a short row when each one finishes. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BACKGROUND_SHELL_TASKS.

orgDefaultModel.description: Desktop: organization default model: Organization admins choose the model new desktop chats start with, for everyone or per team. Applies to the OpenCode v2 engine only; members can still change the model in each chat. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ORG_DEFAULT_MODEL.

gatewayProviderUsageLimits.description: AI Gateway: usage limits per provider: Admins can attach a spend limit to one AI provider. Spend on that provider counts toward its own limit instead of the default limit, and members see which provider ran out. Renders DEN_FEATURE_GATEWAY_PROVIDER_USAGE_LIMITS.

teamAccessRows.description: Team access rows: Team plugin access shows compact rows with clear access sources and a confirmation before revoking a team grant. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TEAM_ACCESS_ROWS.

teamPageTabs.description: Team page: Browser and Models tabs: Each team's page, and Everyone's, gets a Browser tab for the pages agents and the built-in browser can open, and a Models tab with the AI providers the team can use, its spend limits and its default model. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TEAM_PAGE_TABS.

inviteLinkVerifiesEmail.description: Invite links verify the invited email: Creating an account from an invitation link, emailed or shared by an admin, counts as verifying that email, so the invited person joins without entering an emailed code. Renders DEN_FEATURE_INVITE_LINK_VERIFIES_EMAIL.

remoteSessionSubagents.description: Desktop: tasks on other computers as sub-agents: A task the agent starts on the cloud or another computer shows in the chat like a sub-agent: whether it is working, needs an answer or finished, and its conversation, which people can open, follow up on and stop. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_SUBAGENTS.
